about: Labelled training examples for the embedding-based intent classifier. These are TRAINING data, not evaluation data: the classifier is fitted on them, so its score on them is meaningless by construction. Every phrasing here was written to be distinct from eval/intent_queries.json, eval/held_out_intent_queries.json, eval/held_out_intent_queries_2.json and eval/held_out_intent_queries_3.json. If a phrasing needs to move between this file and an eval file, it must be rewritten rather than copied, or the eval stops measuring anything.
